The beginning:
Before the time of Natell Makěj, the 4 kingdoms that make up modern day Akhratia were at a constant and never ending war between each other.
It went on like this for nearly 2000 years.
During this time different groups of people all with the same dna (btw) developed similar but unique versions of each others culture, language, and religion.
The time of Natel Makěj:
Throughout these perilous times the 2 kingdoms Rhaggue, the furthest south and east kingdom, and Odepa, the central kingdom developed very close bonds and even started using the same language, architecture, and warfare tactics.
Eventually the Odepa Prince Heneř zelápen married the Rhagguene princess Natell and unified the kingdoms.
Eventually after many tragedies and losses Natell renamed the union of Rhaggue and Odepa to Akhratia.
And after many years of war Natell, the first emprá of Akhratia conquered the west kingdom of Glade. But when she got the northern kingdom she unfortunately died due to tuberculosis. But seeing that her mothers work was unfinished her eldest daughter fully conquered and unified what is now Akhratia (Akhratia means unity in Akhratian)
AFTER THAT:
After the period known as the conquering the empire of Akhratia went through many famous and wildly recognized periods of time.
The first period of time after the conquering was known as the rebirth, a time of scientific mathematical and cultural developments throughout the empire, different rulers, each one of them known for building many famous buildings, including many famous cathedrals castles trading centers and markets.
The second period after that was known as the spread this. Saw the the spread of the most prominent religion in Akhratia, Celestine. Kattaeň the pure, and Bobaná the holy.
The third period of time after the conquering was known as Mataís empire this period of time was one of Croatia so most of its expansion in colonial territories there are many famous stories, buildings, cultural, and scientific advancements, and people from this time
The fourth period of time after the congruent was called the rebuilding. This was the longest period of many prominent leaders throughout Akhratia as well as seeing the largest and most important medical breakthroughs. This is the period that led into the modern day Akhratia.
Modern day Akhratia: is ruled by the empress Tvirína Makěj.
Currently the empire is trying to rebuild their borders by claiming some of the loss Island territories land that was lost throughout wars and prominent locations, mountains, forest and cities that have massive ties to the empire.
Using historical contact current expansion would help bring a Croatia back to the golden days of their economy of their population and of their science, math, educational and religious development.
Economic and energy reasons:

In today world, global economy is changing fast. More and more, countries and people look for clean energy, technology, and electric power. My empire is already focused on this future. We are almost completely electric based. This means we do not rely on oil, coal, or gas like old powers do. But to keep our systems strong and growing, we need many important minerals and metalslike lithium, cobalt, copper, and rare earthsthat support electric energy and technologies.
Expansion of my empire will help not only us, but also the world economy. Why? Because when we grow, we can access more of these resources, and we use them smartlynot wasteful or greedy. Many places with these minerals are not stable, or they are used for profit only, not for building a cleaner world. In my empire, we invest in infrastructure, in energy systems that give power to people, not just to companies. We build transport, industry, and homes that use electric systems in efficient and sustainable way.
When we expand, we bring these electric technologies to new regions. We create jobs, develop local economy, and connect more people to modern grid and clean power. This reduces world carbon output and gives other nations chance to benefit from
So in conclusion
Expansion of my countrys borders is not just a strategy for landit is a way to secure our future, protect our people, and improve our quality of life. Right now, we face many challenges: growing population, need for more resources, economic pressure, and global competition. If we expand wisely and with purpose, our whole country can become stronger, more stable, and more independent.
First, expansion brings access to natural resourcesminerals, farmland, water, and especially materials that are important for our electric-based systems. Our economy is moving fast into clean energy, electric transport, and advanced technology. But to keep this growth, we need more lithium, copper, cobalt, and rare metals. These are not always easy to find in our current borders. Expanding gives us chance to secure these supplies without depending on foreign powers or unstable markets.
Second, more land means more space for development. We can build more cities, housing, factories, and farms. This helps reduce overcrowding in some areas and creates new jobs and industries in others. Our people can spread out and find new opportunities. It also helps our military and security, giving us stronger positions and safer borders to defend.
Third, expansion can help unite people who share our values, culture, or language but are separated now. It can bring stability to regions that suffer from poor governance or conflict. By expanding, we can offer them better infrastructure, services, and protection. We dont want to conquerwe want to build something better, together.
Finally, when our country grows, our influence grows too. We can trade more, lead more, and defend our interests in the world stage. A bigger, stronger country means we are not pushed

[u][b]Entry of the Arenese navy into the West Elsyer Theater[/b][/u]

[i]At around 12PM, the Arenese navy rushed into the waters of British Bob, bringing multi-use missile carriers, and frigates that were made specifically to explode drones and missiles out of the air. The carriers bore mostly air superiority aircraft, but a lot of air defense aircraft meant to shoot missiles from the air. Two experimental planes were also put onto the carriers. These planes would serve as the main anti- anti-air missile destroyer thingy. The weapon used on these two planes were two laser weapons powered by two large generators that took up most of the plane's insides. Before, the Arenese government has rules that laser weapons were not as useful as they thought they were, but that was in 2013 with bad funding, and there are newer technologies to improve the weapon in these modern times. Focusing on the navy itself, the missile carriers hold 1/4 ship-to-air missiles, 1/4 ship-to-ship missiles, and 1/2 anti-missile missiles.[/i]

[b][u]Squadron A settles at the south of Techno's (whatever you call the tail thingy)[/u][/b]

Note: im waiting for [nation]BR Bob[/nation] and [nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation]'s navy to push.

Squadron A moves about ~50 miles off of (techno's tail thingy)'s coast. The way they achieved it was through cyber attacks and cutting off most signals. Though even this was not enough to sneak by, as a local fisherman saw the Arenese navy and contacted the Technokratisches Navy. The Arenese navy was now enabled to kill him, but chose not to. But now the Technocratic navy knew Squadron A was out there, and it was only a matter of time.

The carrier from Squadron A dispatched three scout planes to cover the area within 150 miles. To cover these scout planes, three additional UAV scouting aircraft were sent out in places that the manned planes couldn't cover. These planes would help the defense of Squadron A, and could also be used as an early attack. The planes were equipped with six air-to-air missiles if they were to encounter anything. The form of communication was an encoded radio transmission that broadcasted to three different places at three different times on three different parts of the plane, meaning it would be very hard to disrupt, unless you were to cover the plane with radio scrambling technology.

[b][u]The Ministry of the Matrix stops gendarmite war propaganda and jamming attacks.[/u][/b]

In the Circle, there lay a large table in the shape of a pentadecagon. This 15 sided table was made for the Ministry of the Matrix. The Ministry of the Matrix, nicknamed "The Spiders", is a Ministery of the Arenese government that deals with everything online. From managing small games, to international cyber-attacks, The Spiders do it all. They have a program called "Protocol W.A.V.E." W.A.V.E stands for "Wide-spectrum Alteration of Vibrational Emissions" It is used to alter electromagnetic waves, sort of like the ones that TV's use to produce video and audio. The protocol is very experimental, but so far the tests have gone accordingly. The public does not know this exists, so that the military and government cant be targeted as much. To cover this information, the government has made a disinformational conspiracy theory called "Project R.E.S.O.N.A.N.C.E." that follows a similar enough idea to W.A.V.E, except branches off into alien lizard illuminati stuff.

[i]"The recent attacks on Bobian televisions have been proven bad."[/i] says a man in a camo-blue suit, presumably the informant. [i]If they keep making these attacks, the Bobian population will go into major shock and eventually surrender.[/i]

[i]"Then stop the attacks."[/i] says the assistant Minister of the Matrix.

[i]"What do you mean stop the attacks? our information base on his mainland has also been attacked virtually. There is no way we can reach the bobian computers from here, or even the most northern of islands owned by the ASSR."[/i] replies the informant.

[i]"Then don't do it from our islands. Do it from Bob's islands. You should have known that two days ago, the information base recovered and is actively blocking cyber-attacks." [/i] informs the assistant.

[i]"it's settled. we will use Protocol W.A.V.E. from our information center in Bob. Our engineers that we sent there should have transferred the protocol information there secretly enough."[/i] states the Minister of the Matrix.

[i]"Pro-Protocol W.A.V.E? But its experimental and unfinished. Sure, some tests against electro-"[/i] The head of the Cybersecurity Department interrupts the assistant with [i]"Protocol W.A.V.E is the only option. Traditional defense won't work, we need to directly alter and phase out the electromagnetic waves."[/i]

[i]"Alright. I'll have the satellites in place in not two days."[/i] The Minister of the Matrix finalized, [i]This better work. Though I do believe it will."[/i]

The Minister of the Matrix gives the go to initiate Protocol W.A.V.E. (ooc: its not future technology. essentially all it does right now is alter and phase out the electromagnetic waves)

[b]A resposta bravanoriana[/b].
"Majestade"
A voz do diretor Gaspar Reis ressoou pelas paredes claras com cortinas azuis e brancas, o imperador João, sentado em seu trono com um manto com as cores nacionais segurando um cajado de ouro, levantou a cabeça sutilmente para o diretor e o disse:
"Fale, diretor Reis."
O diretor imediatamente fez uma reverência e continuou, conforme ordem do imperador:
"As forças do TK já fizeram seu avanço, eles estão atacando o THEP, não é apenas TK vs THEP, os elseyranos...EDU, já fizeram seu avanço também, vossa majestade."
O imperador de imediato não respondeu, apenas pensou;
"Mal entramos nessa aliança e já temos guerra para enfrentar...3 milhões de civis cruzando a fronteira para invadir um país...que mundo é esse em que vivemos??"
O imperador por fim , o respondeu:
"Pois bem, então, devido o ministro Teixeira estar hospitalizado, eu vós nomeio ministro imperial da guerra [i]en tempore[/i] até o final desta guerra."
"Eu aceito de bom grado, vossa majestade, estou grato por essa chance, e não irei a desperdiçar!"
"Muito bem."
O imperador o respondeu e se levantou de seu trono e ficou de pé ereto e tocou o cetro imperial na testa de Reis, e o falou;
"Ave império."
O recém nomeado ministro então fez uma contingência ao imperador, e repetiu:
[b][i]"Ave império."[/i][/b]
.
.
.
Mais tarde naquele dia, Gaspar se encontrava em seu novo escritório,  ele olhava pela janela, a capital São José parecia bem movimentada, sutis, mas visíveis,  Sentinelas DA 200 estavam , a cidade era bem guardada e protegida de ameaças aéreas, no topo do palácio imperial e do Senado eram onde estavam alguns dos poucos TRIUMFO 500 produzido.
"Uma guerra direta não é preferível...mas será necessária, já movemos uma parte da marinha para os arenett, exatamente por isso...ugh, detesto estar diretamente envolvido nesses assuntos...preferia como foi em Capricórnio, mas, devo seguir as ordens do imperador..."
O diretor pegou seu telefone e então ligou ao marechal Constantino Machado.
"Marechal Constantino, aqui é o Diretor Reis falando, eu fui nomeado oficialmente pelo imperador está manhã como [i]ministro imperial da guerra en tempore[/i], como minha primeira ordem nessa posição...é que você treine os seus soldados, Bravanor não irá se envolver diretamente nessa guerra....ainda, mas é melhor estarmos preparados, já ordenei ao ministro(da propaganda )Tavares para iniciarmos campanhas de alistamento , em algum momento iremos enviar forças expedicionários, mas isso deverá ser debatido no senado, por enquanto, fomos apenas permitidos conceder equipamentos."
"Entendido, irei o fazer assim que chegar no quartel, estou agora no meio da estrada."
"Entendo"
A ligação terminou.
.
.
.
[b]um comunicado importante.[/b]
"Aos membros do THEP, nossos caros aliados, o império os oferece equipamentos de defesa imperiais, como o TRIUNFO 400, SAAMA, radares SABRE e nossas defesas AA classe sentinela,  por favor respondam assim que puder."
Para mais informações acesse:
https://www.nationstates.net/nation=demste/detail=factbook/id=2657410
[b]The Bravanorean response[/b].
"Your Majesty."
Director Gaspar Reis's voice echoed through the pale walls with blue and white curtains. Emperor João, seated on his throne in a robe in the national colors and holding a golden staff, raised his head subtly to the director and said:
"Speak, Director Reis."
The director immediately bowed and continued, as ordered by the emperor:
"The TK forces have already made their advance. They are attacking THEP. It's not just TK vs. THEP, the Elseyrans...EDU, have already made their advance too, your majesty."
The emperor didn't immediately respond, only thinking:
"We've barely joined this alliance and we already have a war to fight...3 million civilians crossing the border to invade a country...what kind of world are we living in?" The emperor finally replied:
"Very well, then, since Minister Teixeira is hospitalized, I hereby appoint you Imperial Minister of War [i]en tempore[/i] until the end of this war."
"I gladly accept, Your Majesty. I am grateful for this opportunity, and I will not waste it!"
"Very well."
The emperor responded, rising from his throne and standing erect, touched the imperial scepter to Reis's forehead, and spoke:
"Hail, empire."
The newly appointed minister then made a contingency to the emperor, and repeated:
[b][i]"Hail, empire."[/i][/b]
.
.
Later that day, Gaspar sat in his new office, looking out the window. The capital of São José seemed bustling with activity. Subtle but visible DA 200 sentries were stationed. The city was well-guarded and protected from aerial threats. Some of the few TRIUMPH 500s produced were located atop the imperial palace and the Senate.
"A direct war isn't preferable...but it will be necessary. We've already moved part of the navy to the Arenets, precisely for that reason...ugh, I hate being directly involved in these matters...I'd prefer it to be the way it was in Capricorn, but I must follow the emperor's orders..."
The director picked up his phone and called Marshal Constantino Machado. "Marshal Constantino, this is Director Reis speaking. I was officially appointed by the Emperor this morning as [i]Imperial Minister of War en tempore[/i]. My first order in this position is that you train your soldiers. Bravanor will not be directly involved in this war...yet, but we'd better be prepared. I've already ordered Minister (of Propaganda) Tavares to begin enlistment campaigns. At some point, we will send expeditionary forces, but that will have to be debated in the Senate. For now, we've only been allowed to provide equipment."
"Understood, I will do so as soon as I arrive at the barracks. I'm currently on the road."
"Understood."
The call ended.
.
.
. [b]An important announcement.[/b]
"To the members of THEP, our dear allies, the Empire offers you Imperial defense equipment, such as the TRIUNFO 400, SAAMA, SABRE radars, and our Sentinel-class AA defenses. Please respond as soon as possible."
For more information, visit:
https://www.nationstates.net/nation=demste/detail=factbook/id=2657410

[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59990275][spoiler=[b]Skies and Seas[/b]]

The chaff spraying missiles launched by the air defense systems before they were swiftly destroyed would have little effect on the SM-6s. The SM-6 missiles traveling at hypersonic speeds would be extremely hard to intercept as they rocket toward the retreating enemy aircraft. Datalink would allow the missiles to bypass chaff as radars from a wide variety of systems: aircraft, ships and others would allow the missile to continue to be accurate. The SM-6s would likely cause significant damage to the retreating aircraft, their speed far outpacing that of the aircraft. 

Grounding the aircraft would prove to be a blunder. No longer mobile, the aircraft proved to be a target for long-range cruise missile strikes. 90 Donnerkeil cruise missiles are dispatched to the runways and air bases where the aircraft are parked to destroy them along with aviation fuel. 

Drones would be largely ineffective. Large swarm tactics werent utilized by the loitering munitions. The large number of drones would quickly disperse, stay low to avoid detection and would lack on emissions to avoid other drones finding them. Their stealth and quick execution would make them deadly especially as they go after the anti-air systems in the south. A total of five drones are taken out by the swarm but most of them continue to move towards the anti-air. 

As the drones approached the J-16CJ strike groups the ships would use their THOR systems to destroy them in the sky. High powered microwaves would slam into the swarm frying its electronics and forcing them to fall out of the sky. 

Again the activation of even more air defense would paint another target for the Reichswehr. The J-16CJ strike groups would slam their REG-3000 missiles, salvo after salvo towards the southern air defenses. The aim would be to pair those missiles with drones to ensure their destruction. 

The submarines would inflict limited damage on the fleet. Anti-submarine aircraft, deploying sonobuoys would allow the fleet to detect the submarines 100 km outuncomfortably close but manageable. Using a mix of passive and active detection the movements and locations of the submarines would be parsed together. 

LANCELOT-AR missiles would be deployed again. These hypersonic missiles would have a far longer range than torpedoes. Once it gets close to the subs they would drop their torpedo payloads which hone onto the subs. ASW helicopters using magnetic anomaly detectors would pick up on the subs as well and fire their own LANCELOT-AR payloads. 

However, the defenses, although significant, wouldn't prove invincible. The MS Eisenfels cargo ship would be sunk by a torpedo attack along with damage to a patrol corvette.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Green Light[/b]]

Optimal conditions for an amphibious landing into eastern Hydronia had been reached. Hydronia's air force had been grounded. The navy had been pushed back and heavily damaged by combined losses in their own waters and in Nestorstaat. Only southern air defenses remained in Hydronia and even those being pummeled by REG-3000s. The Kaiserreich now held de facto air and naval superiority in the area. 

Now was the perfect time to land the Marineinfantriekorps in eastern Hydronia.
